correctness.rationale: All bracket and triple-bracket identities follow from six matrix units. The exceptional plane and two types of projective incidence are exhaustive; s=L-1-h. Counting projected bases and free lifts gives sBq^6 ordered filiform generating pairs and hBq^6+B(q-1)q^5+(q^2-1)(L-1)(q-1)q^5 Heisenberg pairs. Division by Bq^4 and Bq^2 respectively is exact for each abstract type. Both exhaustive q=2,3 programs passed; general proof does not rely on experiments.

value.rationale: n4 is the first strict niltriangular Lie algebra of class three; exact embedded Heisenberg/filiform two-generated counts describe how two-generator subalgebras cross a genuine nilpotency-class boundary. The characteristic-two jump is governed by a projective line versus two isolated planes, a nonroutine structural phenomenon not implied by the already known abelian-plane count. Gives exact rational random-generation probabilities and a natural nonabelian subalgebra census.
